description.value: PIVA Modern Italian is a fine-dining restaurant on New Westminster's Columbia Street serving seasonal Italian cuisine — traditional dishes, meat, and seafood — alongside an extensive BC and Italian wine list and craft cocktails. The restaurant offers both indoor seating and a patio, and accommodates intimate dinners, weddings, and corporate events. Wheelchair accessible, it sits in the heart of a walkable downtown corridor convenient for cyclists passing through New Westminster.
